text: すき　かって　やられちゃ　こまるんだぜ！

structure.jp: すき　かって　やられちゃ
structure.en: if you go doing whatever you please (to us)

patterns.name: 〜てはこまる
patterns.span: やられちゃ　こまる
patterns.explanation: ては plus こまる says 'it would be trouble if that happened', a way of saying 'don't'. ちゃ is the short spoken form of ては. やられちゃ こまる = 'we can't have you doing that'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb form says the thing is done to the speaker, here something unwelcome. やられ = 'having it done to us'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining how things are. こまるんだ = 'it's a problem, you see'.
